findingDetails.title: Residue gate misses camelCase transport identifiers
findingDetails.evidence: Live openDesignLineageDigest and OPEN_DESIGN routing identifiers are not matched by the REQ-003/004 or plan residue expressions.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Search for openDesign|OpenDesign|OPEN_DESIGN found live shared proof/routing materials and a live fixture outside the deleted skill tree.
findingDetails.recommendation: Expand the gate to camelCase/uppercase variants or use a canonical token inventory, then classify/remove every live occurrence.

claimAdjudication.claim: The final residue gate can report zero while live camelCase/uppercase transport identifiers remain.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether identifiers were confined to the deleted tree or documented historical exclusions; live shared files and a public fixture also contain them.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: They may be intended historical protocol labels, but no exclusion is documented for these live shared files and the requirement says zero live references.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: Amend the allowlist/gate to classify these exact identifiers as historical, or remove/rename live occurrences and prove the expanded gate.

findingDetails.title: Inventory omits live mcp-tooling discovery fixtures
findingDetails.evidence: Captured list_tools payload includes open_design.open_design.*; equivalent hits exist in Aside and Refero fixtures, while the plan names only mcp-figma and does not classify these snapshots.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Targeted grep over .opencode/skills/mcp-tooling found Aside, Refero, and Mobbin discovery fixtures with Open Design identifiers; none is in the plan affected-surface table or documented exclusion.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add the three fixture paths to the inventory and explicitly edit them or document them as historical exclusions, updating REQ-008/gate scope accordingly.

claimAdjudication.claim: The removal plan inventory is incomplete for tracked mcp-tooling fixtures, leaving a deterministic residue-gate/classification failure.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether these paths match the packet benchmark/.private historical exclusion or occur only under worktrees; they are tracked discovery fixtures under live .opencode skill trees.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: They may be immutable probe snapshots; if so, the packet must explicitly list them as historical and exclude them rather than silently omitting them.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: Document these exact fixture paths as historical/generated exclusions, or add them to the edit inventory and verify post-removal contents.
